About the Department

The Department of Management Studies was established in 2004 with a clear vision and philosophy centered on effectively running and managing academic programs that uniquely integrate both management principles and technology. Since its inception, the department has been dedicated to propelling academic excellence through innovative pedagogical approaches, embracing blended learning methodologies that foster a comprehensive and holistic self-development process. This approach actively cultivates creativity, facilitates dynamic exchange of knowledge, and empowers both students and faculty members to continually enrich their skills and perspectives. The department currently offers two flagship full-time programs: a rigorous 2-year MBA and a comprehensive Full-Time Ph.D. program. These programs serve as the department’s cornerstone, strategically designed to fulfill its overarching objective of achieving academic excellence. This excellence is pursued through both horizontal expansion—broadening the scope and inclusiveness of educational offerings—and vertical growth—deepening expertise and research capabilities. Together, these initiatives ensure that the department remains at the forefront of management education, seamlessly blending theory and technology to develop future leaders and scholars.

Strength of the Department

The strength of the department is deeply rooted in its highly qualified and diverse faculty, who bring extensive expertise across the intertwined domains of management and information technology. These faculty members hail from a wide spectrum of prestigious institutions renowned for their excellence in education and research. Complementing the core faculty, the department actively collaborates with distinguished industry professionals and academic experts who contribute valuable practical insights and cutting-edge knowledge. This collaboration fosters a rich learning environment that bridges theoretical foundations with real-world applications. Furthermore, the department benefits from the guidance and mentorship of prominent senior academicians from globally recognized business schools and universities, enhancing the academic rigor and international perspective of its programs. The department’s alumni network is a testament to its quality, with graduates successfully placed in leading consulting firms and multinational corporations across varied sectors. Through this robust combination of academic strength, industrial collaboration, and successful alumni, the department continuously sustains its position at the forefront of management education and research.

How to Reach IIIT Allahabad
Railway Stations at Prayagraj (erstwhile Allahabad) are as follows :
1) Allahabad Junction (PRYJ) – Abt. 7 kms from Platform No 1 side
3) Prayag (PRG) – Abt. 13 Kms. from Campus
4) Allahabad City (ALY) (also popularly known as Rambagh Stn) – Abt. 10 Kms from Campus
5) Prayag Ghat (PYG) (also popularly known as Daraganj Stn) – Abt. 14 Kms from Campus
6) Jhusi (JI) – Abt 20 Kms. from Campus
7) Chheoki (ACOI) – Abt. 16 Kms. from Campus
8) Naini (NYN) – Abt.19 Kms. from Campus
The IIIT Allahabad campus is located at Jhalwa (Peepalgaon Road), Allahabad. Allahabad Jn. Railway Station is the first choice for reaching IIIT Allahabad followed by Subedar Ganj. Allahabad Junction is very well connected by Trains from all major places like Delhi, Kolkata, Guwahati, Mumbai, Chennai etc. Indian Railway services to Prayagraj are excellent and quite comfortable. Best is to alight on Platform No. 1 side of Prayagraj Junction and hire an auto rickshaw for about Rs. 200, depending upon day-night timings of your arrival. Ola Taxi Service is also available from Platform No. 1 (locally called Chowk side) and also from Platform No. 6/10 (locally called Civil Lines side).
Allahabad is served by Bamrauli Airport, having the code IXD. Direct flights from Delhi (DEL), Bangalore, Mumbai, Raipur, Kolkata are available from here. It is about 4 kms from the Institute Campus. Ola Taxi again is available in between the Airport terminal and Institute Campus.
IIIT Allahabad Campus is accessible from the main Grand Trunk Road that connects Kanpur to Lucknow. Its 200 Kms from Kanpur and abt 203 Kms from Lucknow (The state Capital). As an identification point, take the road turning that is just opposite to the Dhoomanganj Police Station on the GT Road and travel 2.9 Kms on the self guiding road, so as to reach the Gate No. 2 Entrance Gate (Main Gate) of the Institute.
Alight at the Civil Lines Bus Stand, which is connected to all districts of Uttar Pradesh and also by Sleeper Buses from New Delhi. Civil Lines Bus Stand is about 10 Kms from the Institute Campus, from where local Autos / Battery Rickshaw as well as OLA Taxi is available round the clock. Shared Auto service is also available till upto Dhooman Ganj Police Station, from where another shared auto can be hired to reach Jhalwa Crossing, which is about 1 Km from the Institute Campus. Battery Rickshaws ply from there to Institute Campus. Reserved Autos are available from almost anywhere to anywhere, in Prayagraj (Allahabad).
